title: Don't Forget Your Embeddings: Robust Knowledge Erasure via Precise Editing of Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2606.03695v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As language models are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, the ability to erase specific knowledge from them becomes critical for safety and compliance. Prominent methods seek persistent removal by updating the model's parameters, yet the target knowledge often can be recovered through adversarial prompting or relearning. In this work, we hypothesize this limitation stems in part from existing methods overlooking the embedding layer. To address this, we introduce EMBedding ERasure (EMBER), a plug-n-play erasure module that leverages Sparse Matrix Factorization for precise erasure of concept-related features from token embeddings. Through comprehensive evaluations across diverse concepts on Gemma-2-2B-it and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, we find that augmenting existing methods with EMBER consistently improves erasure efficacy and specificity across task formats, with minimal coherence loss. translated_title: 别忘了你的嵌入层：通过精确编辑嵌入实现鲁棒的知识擦除
translated_abstract: 随着语言模型越来越多地部署到现实世界的应用中，从模型中擦除特定知识的能力对于安全性和合规性变得至关重要。主流方法试图通过更新模型参数来实现持久性删除，然而目标知识往往可以通过对抗性提示或重新学习被恢复。在这项工作中，我们假设这一局限性部分源于现有方法对嵌入层的忽视。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了EMBedding ERasure（EMBER），一个即插即用的擦除模块，它利用稀疏矩阵分解从词元嵌入中精确擦除与概念相关的特征。通过在Gemma-2-2B-it和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上对多种概念进行全面评估，我们发现将EMBER与现有方法相结合，能够在各种任务格式下持续提升擦除的有效性和特异性，同时保持极小的连贯性损失。此外，它还显著提高了擦除的鲁棒性。
tldr: 本文提出EMBER——一个利用稀疏矩阵分解精确编辑词元嵌入的即插即用擦除模块，弥补了现有方法忽视嵌入层的缺陷，显著提升了知识擦除的有效性、特异性以及对抗对抗性提示和再学习攻击的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces EMBER, a plug-and-play erasure module that leverages sparse matrix factorization to precisely edit token embeddings, addressing the neglect of the embedding layer in existing methods and significantly improving the efficacy, specificity, and robustness of knowledge erasure against adversarial prompting and relearning attacks.
